parole.significato: any cart with two wheels which are solid and fixed to the axle, usually drawn by an ox or buffalo
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish قاكلی (kañlı, “any two-wheeled cart”), from Proto-Turkic *kaŋlï, ultimately from Tocharian A klānk- (“to ride”). Cognate with Chagatai [script needed] (qaŋlï), Khakas хаңаа (xañaa), Kipchak [script needed] (qanłï), Old Uyghur 𐽲𐽰𐽺𐽷𐾁𐽶 (kaŋlï), Salar gañli and Shor қаңаа
